1 // synthesizer.mjs — Crucible's persistent Deep-Think DIRECTOR (Wave 3).
2 //
3 // The Synthesizer is a reasoning model in a dedicated, persistent role, SEPARATE
4 // from the Sharks (MASTER-PLAN §7). It STEERS the refinement; it does NOT decide.
5 //   - Persistence (simplified): it carries the LAST ROUND VERBATIM plus a short
6 //     running DIRECTION LOG (open disputes · risk register · probing brief).
7 //   - Oranges suggesting: after each round it proactively suggests what's missing
8 //     or needed two steps downstream (the "two steps ahead" ethos).
9 //   - Director ≠ decider: the decider of convergence is the Judge (bin/judge.mjs)
10 //     + the user. This object has NO decide/lock/converge/reconcile method — by
11 //     construction it cannot grade its own homework.
12 //   - Anti-anchoring: ONE fresh-eyes COLD PASS before each lock — a *new*, no-
13 //     context Synthesizer instance reads the transcripts cold. Material divergence
14 //     is routed to the Judge / a challenge round (`reconcileFreshEyes`), NEVER
15 //     reconciled by the anchored Director.
16 //
17 // Every Synthesizer prompt embeds the current North Star verbatim (the §9 anti-
18 // drift rule), and the role carries a per-role model STAMP (reused from judge.mjs).
19 
20 import { HaltError } from './crucible-lib.mjs';
21 import { stampRole } from './judge.mjs';
22 import { makeReliableAgent } from '../../drivers/reliability.mjs';
23 
24 export const SYNTHESIZER_ROLE = 'Synthesizer';
25 
26 // A process-local sequence so every constructed instance has a unique id — the
27 // fresh-eyes COLD PASS must be a demonstrably DIFFERENT instance from the Director.
28 let SYNTH_SEQ = 0;
29 
30 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
31 // Schemas — the Director's direction and the fresh-eyes cold-pass assessment.
32 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

34 /** One round of direction from the Director (advisory — it steers, never decides). */
35 export const DIRECTION_SCHEMA = {
36   type: 'object',
37   required: ['lean'],
38   properties: {
39     lean: { enum: ['lockable', 'not-lockable', 'unknown'] },
40     openDisputes: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
41     riskRegister: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
42     probingBrief: { type: 'string' },
43     // Oranges suggesting: what's missing / needed two steps downstream.
44     suggestions: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
45   },
46 };
47 
48 /** The fresh-eyes cold pass's INDEPENDENT assessment (no prior context). */
49 export const FRESH_EYES_SCHEMA = {
50   type: 'object',
51   required: ['lean'],
52   properties: {
53     lean: { enum: ['lockable', 'not-lockable', 'unknown'] },
54     concerns: {
55       type: 'array',
56       items: {
57         type: 'object',
58         properties: {
59           severity: { enum: ['BLOCKER', 'MAJOR', 'MINOR', 'NIT'] },
60           // P1 2026-07-25 (journal 0011 item 4): a BLOCKER concern holds the lock
61           // ONLY when accountable — it must name the North-Star criterion it blocks
62           // (criterion) or share a topic with a Shark finding (corroboration). A
63           // bare-vibe BLOCKER is advisory for the Judge and the human, not a veto.
64           criterion: { type: 'string' },
65           topic: { type: 'string' },
66           note: { type: 'string' },
67         },
68       },
69     },
70     note: { type: 'string' },
71   },
72 };

74 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
75 // Prompts — every one embeds the North Star verbatim (§9).
76 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
77 
78 function directionPrompt({ northStar, lastRound, journal, research }) {
79   return [
80     `You are the Crucible SYNTHESIZER — a persistent Deep-Think DIRECTOR. You STEER the`,
81     `refinement; you DO NOT decide convergence (the Judge + the user decide that). Read`,
82     `the LAST ROUND verbatim and your running direction log, then issue direction for the`,
83     `next round and — in the Oranges spirit — proactively SUGGEST what is missing or`,
84     `needed two steps downstream. Reason by EVIDENCE QUALITY, not which side is louder.`,
85     ``,
86     `=== THE NORTH STAR (verbatim) ===`,
87     String(northStar ?? '(none yet)'),
88     `=== END NORTH STAR ===`,
89     ``,
90     `=== LAST ROUND (verbatim) ===`,
91     JSON.stringify(lastRound ?? null, null, 2),
92     `=== END LAST ROUND ===`,
93     ``,
94     `=== YOUR RUNNING DIRECTION LOG (${journal.length} prior entr${journal.length === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'}) ===`,
95     journal.length
96       ? journal.map((e, i) => `#${i + 1} r${e.round} lean=${e.lean} disputes=[${(e.openDisputes || []).join('; ')}]`).join('\n')
97       : '(empty — this is the first direction)',
98     `=== END DIRECTION LOG ===`,
99     research ? `\n=== FRESH RESEARCH INPUT ===\n${typeof research === 'string' ? research : JSON.stringify(research)}\n=== END RESEARCH ===` : '',
100     ``,
101     `Emit: lean (lockable|not-lockable|unknown), openDisputes, riskRegister, probingBrief`,
102     `(what the next round must press hardest on), suggestions (Oranges: what's missing /`,
103     `needed two steps ahead).`,
104   ].join('\n');
105 }
106 
107 function freshEyesPrompt({ northStar, transcripts }) {
108   return [
109     `You are a FRESH-EYES Synthesizer instance with NO prior context: you have never seen`,
110     `this project before and hold NO position. Read the round transcript(s) COLD and form`,
111     `an INDEPENDENT assessment — do not try to agree with anyone. If you see a lock-blocking`,
112     `problem, say so plainly.`,
113     ``,
114     `=== THE NORTH STAR (verbatim) ===`,
115     String(northStar ?? '(none)'),
116     `=== END NORTH STAR ===`,
117     ``,
118     `=== ROUND TRANSCRIPT(S) (the ONLY context you are given) ===`,
119     typeof transcripts === 'string' ? transcripts : JSON.stringify(transcripts, null, 2),
120     `=== END TRANSCRIPTS ===`,
121     ``,
122     `Emit: lean (lockable|not-lockable|unknown), concerns [{severity, criterion, topic, note}], note.`,
123     `For a BLOCKER concern: criterion MUST name the North-Star criterion it blocks (verbatim`,
124     `or by number) and topic MUST be a short stable slug for the issue — a BLOCKER that names`,
125     `no criterion and matches no Shark finding is recorded as ADVISORY, not a lock-veto.`,
126   ].join('\n');
127 }

129 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
130 // The Synthesizer (the Director).
131 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
132 
133 /**
134  * Build the persistent Director. It holds the last round verbatim + a running
135  * direction log and issues advisory direction. It deliberately exposes NO
136  * decision authority (no decide/lock/converge/reconcile) — Director ≠ decider.
137  *
138  * @param {object} o
139  * @param {Function}  o.agent                  the Wave-1 agent seam
140  * @param {?string}  [o.northStar=null]        embedded verbatim in every prompt (§9)
141  * @param {string}   [o.model='claude']        the reasoning model filling the role
142  * @param {string}   [o.family='claude']
143  * @param {string}   [o.mode='default']        'default' | 'enhanced'
144  * @param {Function} [o.log=()=>{}]
145  */
146 export function makeSynthesizer({ agent, northStar = null, model = 'claude', family = 'claude', mode = 'default', log = () => {} } = {}) {
147   if (typeof agent !== 'function') {
148     throw new HaltError(
149       'makeSynthesizer requires an agent() function',
150       'pass the Wave-1 seam: makeSynthesizer({ agent: makeAgentSeam(...).agent })',
151     );
152   }
153 
154   const instanceId = `synthesizer#${++SYNTH_SEQ}`;
155   const stamp = stampRole({ role: SYNTHESIZER_ROLE, model, family, mode });
156 
157   // Wave 1: reliability-wrap the injected seam at its injection point, so the
158   // Director's steering call gets typed retry + round-aware idempotency.
159   // Transparent on the success path (one inner call, opts unchanged).
160   const reliableAgent = makeReliableAgent({ agent });
161 
162   // Persistent state (simplified persistence per §7).
163   const journal = []; // the running direction log
164   let lastRound = null; // the last round, stored VERBATIM
165 
166   /** The Director's currently-held position, synthesized from the direction log. */
167   function position() {
168     const last = journal[journal.length - 1];
169     if (!last) return { lean: 'unknown', openDisputes: [], summary: 'no direction issued yet' };
170     // Accumulate every open dispute raised across the log (the running register).
171     const openDisputes = [...new Set(journal.flatMap((e) => e.openDisputes || []))];
172     return { lean: last.lean, openDisputes, summary: last.probingBrief || '' };
173   }
174 
175   return {
176     role: SYNTHESIZER_ROLE,
177     instanceId,
178     stamp,
179     // Director ≠ decider — explicit, and asserted by the gate test.
180     isDecider: false,
181 
182     position,
183 
184     /** A snapshot of the persistent state (for the fresh-eyes isolation oracle). */
185     snapshot() {
186       return { instanceId, journal: journal.map((e) => ({ ...e })), lastRound, position: position() };
187     },
188 
189     /**
190      * Read the just-completed round, store it VERBATIM, append a direction-log
191      * entry, and return ADVISORY direction (Oranges suggesting included). This is
192      * steering only — `advisory:true, decides:false` is part of the contract.
193      *
194      * @param {object} o
195      * @param {number}  [o.round=0]
196      * @param {object}   o.verdict             the Shark-Tank round verdict (stored verbatim)
197      * @param {?string} [o.northStar]          overrides the instance North Star for this call
198      * @param {?(string|object)} [o.research=null]
199      */
200     async direct({ round = 0, verdict, northStar: ns = null, research = null } = {}) {
201       lastRound = { round, verdict }; // LAST ROUND VERBATIM
202       const star = ns ?? northStar;
203       const out = await reliableAgent(directionPrompt({ northStar: star, lastRound, journal, research }), {
204         label: `synthesizer:direct:r${round}`,
205         schema: DIRECTION_SCHEMA,
206         role: 'synthesizer',
207         round,
208       });
209       const entry = {
210         round,
211         lean: out?.lean ?? 'unknown',
212         openDisputes: Array.isArray(out?.openDisputes) ? out.openDisputes : [],
213         riskRegister: Array.isArray(out?.riskRegister) ? out.riskRegister : [],
214         probingBrief: out?.probingBrief ?? '',
215         suggestions: Array.isArray(out?.suggestions) ? out.suggestions : [],
216       };
217       journal.push(entry);
218       log(`synthesizer direction r${round}: lean=${entry.lean}, ${entry.openDisputes.length} dispute(s), ${entry.suggestions.length} suggestion(s)`);
219       // Advisory by contract — the Director steers, the Judge + user decide.
220       return { ...entry, kind: 'direction', advisory: true, decides: false, stamp };
221     },
222   };
223 }

225 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
226 // The fresh-eyes COLD PASS — a NEW, no-context instance.
227 //
228 // Deliberately a free function (NOT a method on the Director): the anchored
229 // Director must never run or reconcile its own anti-anchoring pass. It spins up a
230 // brand-new Synthesizer with an EMPTY journal and feeds it ONLY the transcripts —
231 // none of the Director's direction log — so the assessment is genuinely cold.
232 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
233 
234 /**
235  * Run the fresh-eyes cold pass. Returns the cold instance's id, its journal AT THE
236  * MOMENT IT READ (which MUST be empty — the isolation invariant), the exact prompt
237  * it was given (so the oracle can prove no Director context leaked in), and its
238  * independent assessment.
239  *
240  * @param {object} o
241  * @param {Function}        o.agent
242  * @param {string|object}   o.transcripts          the round transcript(s) — the only context
243  * @param {?string}        [o.northStar=null]
244  * @param {string}         [o.model='claude']
245  * @param {string}         [o.family='claude']
246  * @param {string}         [o.mode='default']
247  * @param {Function}       [o.log=()=>{}]
248  */
249 export async function freshEyesColdPass({ agent, transcripts, northStar = null, model = 'claude', family = 'claude', mode = 'default', log = () => {} } = {}) {
250   // A NEW Synthesizer with an empty journal — never the anchored Director.
251   const cold = makeSynthesizer({ agent, northStar, model, family, mode, log });
252   const journalAtStart = cold.snapshot().journal; // MUST be [] — the isolation invariant
253   const promptSent = freshEyesPrompt({ northStar, transcripts });
254   // Wave 1: the cold pass's own injected call is reliability-wrapped here too.
255   const reliableAgent = makeReliableAgent({ agent });
256   const out = await reliableAgent(promptSent, { label: `synthesizer:fresh-eyes:${cold.instanceId}`, schema: FRESH_EYES_SCHEMA, role: 'synthesizer' });
257   const assessment = {
258     lean: out?.lean ?? 'unknown',
259     concerns: Array.isArray(out?.concerns) ? out.concerns : [],
260     note: out?.note ?? '',
261   };
262   log(`fresh-eyes cold pass ${cold.instanceId}: lean=${assessment.lean}, ${assessment.concerns.length} concern(s)`);
263   return { instanceId: cold.instanceId, journalAtStart, promptSent, assessment, stamp: cold.stamp };
264 }
265 
266 /**
267  * Isolation oracle: prove the fresh-eyes cold pass received NO prior context.
268  * Confirms (1) the cold instance's journal was empty when it read, (2) it was a
269  * DIFFERENT instance from the Director, and (3) none of the Director's direction-
270  * log text leaked into the cold prompt.
271  *
272  * @param {object} o
273  * @param {object}  o.cold                 the freshEyesColdPass result
274  * @param {?object}[o.directorSnapshot]    the Director's snapshot() (for leak/identity checks)
275  * @returns {{isolated:boolean, violations:string[], leaked:string[]}}
276  */
277 export function freshEyesIsolationOracle({ cold, directorSnapshot = null }) {
278   const violations = [];
279   if (!cold) {
280     return { isolated: false, violations: ['no cold-pass result to inspect'], leaked: [] };
281   }
282   if ((cold.journalAtStart?.length ?? -1) !== 0) {
283     violations.push(`cold instance journal was not empty (len=${cold.journalAtStart?.length}) — it carried prior context`);
284   }
285   if (directorSnapshot && cold.instanceId === directorSnapshot.instanceId) {
286     violations.push('cold pass reused the Director instance instead of a fresh, no-context one');
287   }
288   // Leak check: no Director direction-log text may appear in the cold prompt.
289   const prompt = cold.promptSent || '';
290   const leaked = [];
291   for (const e of directorSnapshot?.journal || []) {
292     const texts = [e.probingBrief, ...(e.openDisputes || []), ...(e.riskRegister || []), ...(e.suggestions || [])];
293     for (const t of texts) {
294       if (t && String(t).length > 3 && prompt.includes(t)) leaked.push(t);
295     }
296   }
297   if (leaked.length) {
298     violations.push(`Director context leaked into the cold prompt: ${leaked.slice(0, 3).join(' | ')}`);
299   }
300   return { isolated: violations.length === 0, violations, leaked };
301 }
302 
303 /**
304  * Reconcile the fresh-eyes pass against the Director's position — a FREE function,
305  * deliberately not a Director method, so the anchored Director never reconciles
306  * its own anti-anchoring pass. Material divergence (the cold pass surfaces a lock-
307  * blocking problem the Director did not hold) is SURFACED TO THE JUDGE; a non-
308  * material divergence recommends one more challenge round.
309  *
310  * @param {object} o
311  * @param {{lean:string}} o.directorPosition
312  * @param {{lean:string, concerns?:object[]}} o.freshEyes
313  * @returns {{diverged:boolean, material:boolean, route:'judge'|'challenge-round'|'concur', reason:string}}
314  */
315 export function reconcileFreshEyes({ directorPosition, freshEyes }) {
316   const dLean = directorPosition?.lean ?? 'unknown';
317   const fLean = freshEyes?.lean ?? 'unknown';
318   const diverged = dLean !== fLean;
319   const freshBlocker = (freshEyes?.concerns || []).some((c) => ['BLOCKER', 'MAJOR'].includes(String(c?.severity || '').toUpperCase()));
320   // Material = the cold pass raises a lock-blocking divergence the Director didn't hold.
321   const material = (diverged && fLean === 'not-lockable') || freshBlocker;
322   const route = material ? 'judge' : diverged ? 'challenge-round' : 'concur';
323   return {
324     diverged,
325     material,
326     route,
327     reason: material
328       ? 'fresh-eyes cold pass materially diverges — surfaced to the Judge (the decider), never reconciled by the anchored Director'
329       : diverged
330         ? 'fresh-eyes diverges non-materially — recommend one more challenge round'
331         : 'fresh-eyes concurs with the Director',
332   };
333 }
